<b>Pinmaster's Oil</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== How to Start ==
The Wish can be acquired by talking to [[Pinmaster Plinney]] after obtaining the first [[Needle#Upgrades|Needle Upgrade]] from him.

This Wish is missable if Pale Oil is brought to Pinmaster Plinney before accepting the Wish. However, acquiring the second Needle Upgrade will still grant the Wish's Quest Point for ''[[Silk and Soul]]'' even if the Wish itself was missed.<!--verification needed-->

|Image1 = Mapshot SS Pinmaster Plinney 01.png!Pinmaster Plinney's location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 10.png!Pinmaster Plinney in Bellhart
}}

== Wish ==
[[File:Pale Oil.png|link=Pale Oil|left|thumb|100x100px]]

To complete the Wish, one of three [[Pale Oil]] glands must be obtained:
* Located in northeast [[Choral Chambers]], accessed through the adjoining room in [[Whispering Vaults]]
* Awarded by [[Loyal Mergwin]] upon completing <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i>
* Awarded by the [[Flea Caravan]] in [[Putrified Ducts]] upon completing <i>[[Ecstasy of the End]]</i>

== Reward ==
[[File:Needle 3 Shining Needle.png|link=Needle|left|thumb|150x150px]]

Pale Oil must be brought to Pinmaster Plinney to complete the quest. In return, Plinney upgrades [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s Sharpened [[Needle]] to Shining Needle. Additionally, if the other Pale Oil glands are subsequently brought, he further upgrades the Needle in exchange for {{R|Rosaries}}.
